Same bioRxiv preprint: identical title, authors, year, DOI, and 'Preprint of Margalit2024' note. Only entry type differs (article vs unpublished).
Identical Neuron 2024 paper: same title, authors, volume/number/pages, and DOI. Only a trailing-initial spacing difference in author (Yamins).
Both are Marr's 'Vision', 2010 MIT Press edition. Differing ISBNs are print vs online of the same edition; same work.
Identical Scientific Reports 2025 article: same title, authors, volume/number, and DOI. Zotero key vs hand key.
Identical Philosophical Psychology 2004 article: same title, author, volume/number/pages, and DOI.
Identical book 'Seeing, Doing, and Knowing' by Matthen 2005, same publisher and ISBN. Only citekey style differs.
Identical Semantics and Pragmatics 2010 article: same title, author, volume, and DOI. Only author name formatting differs.
Identical SEP entry 'Color' by Barry Maund 2015. Only citekey style differs.

Identical Philosophical Psychology 2006 article: same title, authors, volume/number/pages, and DOI.
